Ans = "No"
piano = "wbwbwwbwbwbw"
piano = list(piano)
for j in range(len(piano)):  # Starting position
    for i in range(1, len(piano) - j + 1):  # Length of the substring
        A = [0, 0]
        for k in range(i):  # Count 'w' and 'b' in the substring

                A[0] += 1
            if piano[j + k] == "b":
                A[1] += 1
        if A == [W, B]:
            Ans = "Yes"
            break
    if Ans == "Yes":
        break
